entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's no end to them!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Guys!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: You seem to be in quite a pickle...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How dare you sneak around, Kaneshiro!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Those would be my words.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: However, I do thank you for providing[n]me with such wonderful goods.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: ...It's time you disappear.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Managing a bank is tough as it is. So it's[n]my policy to kill clients who are more[n]trouble than they're worth.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Having one impertinent brat[n]disappear is enough to set an[n]example in that other world.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please stop!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Oh, I wouldn't damage an asset like you.[n]They're dead men walking, but you'll be[n]just fine.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Your sister is quite a beauty though.[n]I'll make sure to make her my personal[n]slave.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Once I get bored, I'll just sell her off.[n]Oh, poor Sis...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: She could've been successful, if only her[n]younger sister wasn't so dumb.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My sister has nothing to do with this!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Then you better start taking customers[n]tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: All you gotta do is endure it and do as[n]you're told.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Endure it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do as I'm told...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: You'll earn three million yen in no time.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Although, your life and everything along[n]with it will be a complete wreck by then!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Gwahahahahaha!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been listening to you go on and on...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Shut your damn mouth, you money-[n]grubbing asshole!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Huh?
